entities.name: Krzysztof Józef Nykiel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Krzysztof Jozef Nykiel is the regent of the Apostolic Penitentiary, who was appointed to the position by Pope Benedict XVI on 26 June 2012. He had previously served as an official of the Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith.
